common.sandboxNoMocks: Test data only. Real data is switched off.
common.offline: You're offline. Changes will be sent when you reconnect.
common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

auth.signInLead: For families, care teams and research partners.
auth.badCredentials: That email and password don't match, or the account is locked for 15 minutes after too many tries.
auth.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then sign in again.
auth.mfaVerifyLead: Open your authenticator app and type the code shown for Tomoni.
auth.mfaEnrollLead: Care teams and partners need a second step, because you can see patient information. Scan this code with an authenticator app, then type the 6 digits it shows.
auth.mfaManual: Can't scan? Enter this key instead:
auth.badCode: That code didn't match. Codes change every 30 seconds; try the newest one.
auth.chooseSurface: Where do you want to go?
auth.wrongApp: This account is for the research partner portal. Sign in there instead.
auth.notPartner: This portal is for research partners only. Families and care teams sign in to the main Tomoni app.

family.emptyBody: Once Tomoni has checked your family's medicines, each person's status shows here every morning, with anything that needs you at the top.

desk.queueEmptyBody: Refill renewals, approvals and nurse flags appear here, most urgent first.
desk.detailEmpty: Pick an item from the queue. Its evidence shows here, so you never have to look anything up.

ops.title: Escalations
ops.emptyBody: Calls the assistant hands over, and jobs that need a person, appear here.

sponsor.title: Research partner portal
sponsor.lead: Counts here are de-identified and aggregated. Groups smaller than 11 people are never shown.
sponsor.emptyBody: When a study is set up with Tomoni, feasibility counts and the referral funnel appear here.
